evidence.name: Screen field: Size of the button label
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Size of the button label" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Size of the button label
sections.description: Sets how large the text on the button appears. Most buttons read well at 16-18; go larger to make a primary action more prominent, but watch that the label doesn't wrap or overflow on small phone screens. Keep it consistent across your buttons so the screen looks intentional.
